title: 分散式檔案系統
summary: 以命名空間、區塊放置與複製復原連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect namespaces, block placement and replica recovery through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 命名與區塊
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「命名與區塊」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop names and blocks through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 命名空間：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「命名空間」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for namespace.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「命名空間」的資料、控制與時間關係。檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫名稱到區塊的映射。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for namespace. File names are separate from block locations. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw name-to-block mappings. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：三份複本同一機架可保證機架失效存活。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Three replicas in one rack guarantee rack-failure survival. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「命名空間」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit namespace two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 命名空間的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。
knowledge.textEn: File names are separate from block locations.

knowledge.title: 命名空間的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫名稱到區塊的映射。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw name-to-block mappings. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設資料 1 TiB，三份完整複本需要 3 TiB；6+3 抹除編碼的理想資料成本為 1.5 TiB。未含 metadata、padding、重建暫存與保留容量；編碼與複製的修復交通不同。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 1 TiB data: three replicas need 3 TiB, while ideal 6+3 erasure coding needs 1.5 TiB. Metadata, padding, rebuild scratch and headroom are omitted; repair traffic differs.

quiz.question: 本步審查「命名空間」與整體「分散式檔案系統」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing namespace within distributed file systems, which statement or check is supported?
options: 檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。
三份複本同一機架可保證機架失效存活。
抹除編碼省容量即代表修復沒有成本。
optionsEn: File names are separate from block locations.
Three replicas in one rack guarantee rack-failure survival.
Erasure coding savings eliminate repair costs.
quiz.explanation: 檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。 畫名稱到區塊的映射。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: File names are separate from block locations. Draw name-to-block mappings. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 命名空間：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「畫名稱到區塊的映射。」檢查「命名空間」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for namespace using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「命名空間」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫名稱到區塊的映射。 核對「檔案名稱與實際區塊位置分離。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for namespace and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw name-to-block mappings. Check the principle: File names are separate from block locations. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：三份複本同一機架可保證機架失效存活。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Three replicas in one rack guarantee rack-failure survival. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「命名空間」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫名稱到區塊的映射。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit namespace input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 讀寫語義：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「讀寫語義」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for read/write semantics.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「讀寫語義」的資料、控制與時間關係。分散檔案介面不必等同所有 POSIX 語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出追加與任意覆寫需求。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for read/write semantics. Distributed interfaces may differ from POSIX semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List append and random-overwrite needs. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 列出追加與任意覆寫需求。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：抹除編碼省容量即代表修復沒有成本。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Erasure coding savings eliminate repair costs. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「讀寫語義」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「分散檔案介面不必等同所有 POSIX 語義。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit read/write semantics two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.title: 讀寫語義：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「列出追加與任意覆寫需求。」檢查「讀寫語義」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for read/write semantics using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「讀寫語義」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：列出追加與任意覆寫需求。 核對「分散檔案介面不必等同所有 POSIX 語義。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for read/write semantics and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: List append and random-overwrite needs. Check the principle: Distributed interfaces may differ from POSIX semantics. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出追加與任意覆寫需求。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：抹除編碼省容量即代表修復沒有成本。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Erasure coding savings eliminate repair costs. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「讀寫語義」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出追加與任意覆寫需求。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit read/write semantics input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
